title: Rabbi Shimon bar Bisna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish in Shabbat 75b according to the Bach’s reading; Hyman gives the ordinary reading as Rabbi Shimon ben Kisna. At the end of Eruvin chapter 1, the Rif has Rabbi Shimon bar Bisna reporting Rabbi Acha. The source is Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin, at the end of 3:4, where the name is Rabbi Shimon bar Karsna.

notes.text: The complete Shabbat 75b paragraph currently reads Shimon ben Kisma. Hyman’s supplied notice gives ben Kisna and records the Bach’s bar Bisna reading.
